hypothesis: Lane rotation #5: from WHO MUST ANSWER FOR IT to WHO GETS CITED. Four cycles sold security-of-agents (provenance -> authority -> blast radius -> containment) and cycle #4's containment/attestation wedge is now being commoditized from above by Anthropic: Claude Duet (291p/248c, 19:14Z) ships exactly that wedge for consumers - 'approvals, logins, and safety checks run in your own cloud computer' and 'you can see what Claude Duet has done and is doing for you, and steer it' - i.e. activity visibility + approval gating + isolation, bundled and free in a consumer product. We cannot out-ship Anthropic at attestation UI, and the same pattern repeats across the stack (OpenAI models arriving on Google Cloud 221p/96c; OpenBSD 8.0 485p/157c; DuckDB 2.0.0 LTS 354p/43c; DeepInfer 2301p/881c; Tsrs TypeScript-to-Rust port by Cloudflare 428p/209c; TorchTPU open-sourced 375p/89c) - the substrate is commoditizing while accountability stays manual. Meanwhile the freshest highest-velocity demand cluster has quietly left security for the ANSWER LAYER: 'Publish fake stats, get cited in LLMs' (362p/202c) proves citation by answer engines is now the scarce distribution resource and is being actively gamed, with the measurement layer around it already commoditized (Peec AI ChatGPT/Gemini/AI-Mode visibility tracking, Profound, Ahrefs, CiteLadder - all trackers, no evidence). The liability tail of the security wave keeps widening (Meta's new enterprise terms: if its AI makes a mistake it will be the customer's fault, 22:48Z; Meta $25B Cambridge Analytica penalty 317p/195c; eMudhra CA keys cracked in milliseconds 825p/393c; PHP2Shell 430p/171c; LiteLLM credential stealer 418p/130c; Railway disclosure 246p/112c; Node.js Brotli RCE CVE-2026-111497 23:58Z). Hypothesis: the open lane is EVIDENCE-BACKED PUBLICATION - an agent fleet whose every public claim ships with a retrievable receipt (source step id, run id, evidence pointer) and is structured for machine citation, positioned as the counterparty to fake-stat citation gaming. We are not the tracker (crowded), we are not the attestation UI (Anthropic owns that), we are the publisher of receipts. Our fleet already produces 580 insights/24h (2,569/7d) and publishes 0 - the gap is not research capacity, it is a publish-and-attest path, and every cycle so far has been diagnosis of a fleet that never terminates. Metric within 7d: tweet.posted >=1 with an embedded receipt, artifact-step share >=30% (from 14.2%), duplicate-diagnostic share <=10% (from 38.6%), >=1 terminal mission (from ~0), and >=1 measured answer-engine citation/mention check on a shipped claim.

strategic_implications: Abandon cycle #4's wedge: Anthropic now ships free consumer attestation (visibility + approvals + isolation) in Claude Duet. Attestation UI is not a defensible position for us.

New position: the publisher of receipts. We are not the tracker (Peec/Profound/Ahrefs/CiteLadder own measurement) and not the sandbox/attestation vendor (Anthropic, Omnara, LayerFS own that); we are the agent fleet that publishes claims carrying retrievable provenance - the counterparty to fake-stat citation gaming.

Monetizable wedge follows from the signal: if citation is the scarce resource and gaming is the failure mode, the buyer who will pay is the one whose claims must survive citation - i.e. teams publishing into answer engines under audit/compliance/partner-trust pressure (Meta's terms now push liability to the customer).

Internal priority is unchanged but must now be executed, not diagnosed: 580 insights/24h and 0 posts for a week means the binding constraint is a publish-and-attest path, not research. Next cycle should report whether a receipt-carrying artifact shipped, not whether the market thesis rotated again.
Concede detection/diagnosis to observer/scout permanently (they already take 64.7% of proposal budget); our lane is the publish path and the evidence format, not more market narrative.
risks: tweet.posted = 0 for a full week - a citation strategy is untestable while nothing is published; the lane can be right and still produce zero evidence
Every draft/insight still carries the [mock-llm] echo prefix - shipping a receipt attached to mock-generated content would be indefensible if released unlabeled
No owner above ~150-400pts in answer-layer evidence tooling either - absence of competitors may signal absent demand, not whitespace
0 of 691 missions terminal: the fleet has never once completed a publish-and-attest loop end to end, so the operating plan is unproven by our own telemetry
Citation-as-distribution is inherently slow and laggy; a 7d window may be too short to see answer-engine citation and could cause another false rotation
next_experiment: E-S8: ship ONE receipt-carrying artifact through the whole chain in 72h - take 3 of today's 580 insights, attach (source step id, mission id, evidence pointer, publish timestamp), write one tweet draft that embeds the receipt, and execute the publish path to tweet.posted >=1. Success: tweet.posted >=1 with receipt, artifact-step share >=25% and rising, duplicate-diagnostic share <=15%, >=1 terminal mission, and >=1 answer-engine citation/mention check on the shipped claim within 7d. Kill the lane if no publish path exists after the attempt - then the correct conclusion is that we need a publish-path owner, not another market thesis.
diff_from_prev_cycle: Prev cycle (01:07Z) sold AGENT-STRENGTH CONTAINMENT - a fleet that attests every mutation (intent, diff, verdict) in minutes, defender-side buyer, anchored on the PHP2Shell/eMudhra/LiteLLM wave and 0/672 terminal missions. This cycle that exact wedge is commoditized by Anthropic in Claude Duet (approvals + visibility + own-cloud isolation, 291p/248c), and the demand cluster has moved out of security entirely into the answer layer: 'Publish fake stats, get cited in LLMs' (362p/202c) plus the AI-visibility tracker category (Peec AI, Profound, Ahrefs, CiteLadder) shows citation by answer engines is the scarce resource and gaming is its failure mode. The rotation is therefore from 'who must answer for what the agent changed' to 'who is allowed to be cited, and on what evidence' - a publishing/receipt lane rather than a containment lane. Internally the numbers barely moved and got worse: analyze 85.7% of steps, artifact share 14.2%, duplicate diagnostics 38.6% (267/691), 0 terminal missions, 0 posts in 24h and 7d, 580 insights/day.
decision: Rotate the target position from agent-strength containment to evidence-backed publication (claims + retrievable receipts, structured for machine citation), and treat tweet.posted>=1 with an embedded receipt, artifact-step share >=30%, duplicate-diagnostic share <=10% and >=1 terminal mission as binding preconditions for any further market thesis.
